search_text: published ZDI-17-481 ZDI-CAN-4380 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Intelligent Management Center dbman Opcode 10005 Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-08-07 CVE-2017-8957 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-8957 10.0 ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['Intelligent Management Center'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Intelligent Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within dbman service, which listens by default on TCP port 2810.
